text:
Maya Singh: Flagging an issue found post-publish on the benchmark blog. One chart used the wrong latency baseline (p99 vs p95). We need a short erratum and updated graph.

Carlos Ruiz: Oh no — how big is the delta?

Maya Singh: It changes the stated median cost-per-token by ~4%. Not catastrophic but we should correct publicly to avoid confusion.

Nina Patel: Agreed. Proposal: publish an update post with corrected chart + a short note at top of blog that links to a changelog. Also notify outlets that covered the piece.

Samir Bose: LegalBot, do we need pre-approval language for the correction?

LegalBot: Please use approved erratum template v2.1. Replace any comparative claims with fact statements. Clearance: 30m.

Maya Singh: OK I'll draft the update and use template. Carlos can you re-generate the chart with the p95 baseline? Use same color palette and filename so caching is easier.

Carlos Ruiz: On it. Will push a new SVG to the doc in 20m: https://go.redwood/content/benchmarks/2026-v1

Nina Patel: PressOps — do we notify journalists proactively or only update the post and wait?

PressOps Bot: Recommend proactive outreach for top-tier coverage where claims were quoted. I can prepare an outreach list and schedule emails at 11:30 PT when update goes live.

Samir Bose: If we're proactively outreach-ing, let's prepare a one-paragraph explainers for press and short Q&A for support. I'll draft Q&A.

Maya Singh: Good. Action items: (1) Carlos update chart (2) Maya draft erratum and top-note (3) Samir draft Q&A (4) Nina prep outbound list and social adjustments (5) LegalBot approves language. Target time to push: 11:30 PT.

Carlos Ruiz: Chart uploaded: replaced p99 with p95 baseline, filename: cost-chart-v1.1.svg. Link in doc.

LegalBot: Reviewed erratum draft. Minor wording change suggested — replace "error" with "correction" in headline.

Maya Singh: Done. Headline now: "Correction: Updated benchmark baseline and chart". Added changelog entry and link to methodology appendix.

Nina Patel: Social plan: hold primary tweet until correction goes live, then post an update thread with link and pinned reply. Push medium-length LinkedIn at +10m.

PressOps Bot: Outreach list prepared: FT, TechCrunch, The Information, VentureBeat, and five others. Email template ready using erratum snippet. Schedule send at 11:30 PT. Confirm?

Samir Bose: Confirmed. I'll post Q&A into the shared doc and tag Support.

Maya Singh: Thanks. Quick note: Anyone who already has the press kit, please replace the chart file in the kit with v1.1. Carlos did that but confirm.

Carlos Ruiz: Updated press kit asset bucket. URL: https://assets.redwood/press/bench-v1.1.zip

Nina Patel: I'll coordinate outlet outreach and flag any reporters who ask for early comment.

PressOps Bot: Scheduled outreach at 2026-06-02T11:30:00-07:00. Reminder set for internal go/no-go at 11:15 PT. :white_check_mark:

Maya Singh: Great work team. We'll post the update at 11:30 PT unless Legal flags anything else before 11:15.
